# Sample Skill

This skill exists solely so that `tests/fixtures/broken-plugin/` is a
structurally valid Claude Code plugin. It has no behavior of its own and is
not exercised by any of the fixture's deliberate defects — those live on the
agent files added in later phases (10b/10c).
